Brand story

Most editors cut footage. We shape stories.

9 years across feature film, documentary, NGO, and long-form YouTube distilled into one focused discipline: the craft of making stories hold.

We work where long-form essay video meets documentary. These are the two formats where pacing is an argument, and where a single cut changes what an audience believes.

What we bring that most editors don't: narrative consultation before we touch the timeline. Structure first. Then the edit.

Selected work

Case study 01 · Long-form essay · Featured

10 films we edited,3.6M views.

We're part of the editing team on Dr. Jonathan Tam's channel, which grew from zero to 141K subscribers in 417 days. Ten of its films are ours, and one has passed 2M views.

The channel · subscribers, public readings

The brief

Turn dense, research-heavy scripts on society and culture into long-form essay videos for an English-speaking audience, and keep average view duration strong across 19 to 40 minutes.

The challenge

Essay content fails when it turns into a lecture. Our job is to make the argument feel like a discovery, pacing each reveal so the audience stays curious.

The approach

We build the edit around the script's argument. Motion graphics clarify the data, and sound design marks the key moments across long runtimes.

Case study 02 · Short-form social

eToro Australia. Made for the feed.

Short-form content for TikTok and Reels around eToro's A-Leagues football sponsorship.

Watch on TikTok

Project details

Client
eToro Australia
Agency
Planaria Studio
Format
TikTok · Reels · Shorts
Context
A-Leagues sponsorship
Market
Australia
Our role
Senior video editor

The brief

Branded entertainment for eToro Australia's TikTok and Reels channels that feels native to the platform and nothing like an ad.

The challenge

Sponsorship content has to earn attention in the first two seconds, in a feed full of professional sports content.

The approach

Hook-first cuts built on platform formats such as challenges, trivia and on-field activations. Fast pacing for the scroll, with eToro's brand tone kept credible.

A note on short-form

Short-form sharpens our long-form. Earning attention in two seconds is the same skill as holding it for forty minutes.

The challenge

Launch a new film IP in three markets at once, with no franchise history and no marketing budget. The editing style had to work as the brand.

The editorial problem

Every short had a different director. Our job was making a viewer in Melbourne and one in Jakarta recognise the same hand, through rhythm, pacing and structure rather than dialogue.

The result

1.7M organic views and 8K+ subscribers from zero, with no marketing budget behind it.

Case study 04 · Brand documentary

Hyatt Regency Bali. 50 years, one throughline.

A 50th-anniversary documentary, directed and edited end to end, with global distribution.

Watch the documentary

The brief

Direct and edit a documentary marking 50 years of Hyatt's Bali property, with full creative control from pre-production to final delivery.

The narrative challenge

Fifty years of history holds dozens of possible stories. The editorial work started before the shoot, finding the one throughline that would feel personal to a global audience.

The result

Shown across Hyatt's official channels: in-hotel TV, global social media, websites and YouTube. A film built to outlast any campaign.

Project details

Why it matters

Brands with heritage need an editor who can find the story. Hyatt gave us the whole film, from pre-production to final cut.

Also for hotels · Hard Rock Hotel Bali · 25th anniversary · 2023

The brief said anniversary. The real job was getting nineties guests to book again.

We built the film around what former guests remember, not what the hotel wanted to say about itself. It drew responses on social from former guests saying they planned to return. Directed and edited by us.

Case study 05 · NGO documentary series

Scholars of Sustenance. Films that move donors.

A long-form impact documentary series for a food-rescue NGO working across Bali and Java.

Watch the series

The brief

Build the video function from scratch. Sole editor, strategist and producer for two years, behind every video donors, partners and the public saw.

The narrative challenge

NGO films have to document the truth and move people to act. The aim was to make the audience feel agency rather than guilt.

The result

IDR 2 billion raised across two fundraising events. Forty-plus films reached 5,000 donors and supporters, and ten campaigns brought in 1,000 new donors.

Case study 06 · Theatrical trailers

Jomblo & Mekah, I'm Coming. Ninety minutes, two to sell it.

Two theatrical trailer campaigns for Indonesian features, released by Falcon Pictures and MD Pictures.

Jomblo trailer Mekah, I'm Coming trailer

4M+

online views across two campaigns

The problem

Compress a ninety-minute film into two minutes that sell tickets, without giving away the turns.

The approach

We treat the trailer as its own three-act story: setup, escalation, cliffhanger. Sound design hits on the visual beats instead of sitting under them.
